reply.subject: RM_FurnaceBeast

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one shared scale on a checkerboard. South: a massive stone-plated quadruped seen from the front. It has a small blunt head low between its shoulders and a stepped ridge of plates rising behind. East: a long, low side profile with a high jagged dorsal ridge over the shoulders, the head held low on the right, and a rounded plated rump on the left. North: the rump seen from behind, with a segmented, tapering tail hanging down the middle and the dorsal ridge rising above it. All three are similar in height and use the same palette: grey stone with tan and ochre bands and orange-glowing cracks.
observed.south.png: Front view with the face toward the camera: two small dark eyes, a flat blunt muzzle and a straight mouth line. The head sits low between broad plated shoulders. The legs are thick, columnar and banded, ending in rounded stone toes. The plates are layered sedimentary-looking rock with orange light in the seams at the shoulders and chest. A small hanging plate sits under the belly, and stepped dorsal plates rise behind the head. The background is clean transparency with no ground or shadow.
observed.east.png: A true side profile facing right, with an eye visible on the low, blunt, tortoise-like head. The body is a long barrel of interlocking banded stone plates, ochre and grey striped, with glowing orange fissures, mainly at the shoulder and haunch. A tall, jagged ridge of tilted slab plates rises over the mid-back. The rear end is a rounded plated mass that droops into a short tapering tail shape at the lower left. There are four thick legs with stone toes. The cut-out is clean, with no ground.
observed.north.png: Rear view: wide plated haunches, a segmented conical tail hanging down the centre, and the dorsal ridge rising above, seen end-on. No face or eyes are visible. Orange glow shows in the seams beside the tail base. The hind legs are thick and banded with stone toes, and the forelegs are partly visible behind. The cut-out is clean.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the hide reads as finely painted banded rock with glowing cracks, crisp at 128 px per cell. In normal play at 32 px per cell, the beast is about 7 cells long and about 4 cells tall, dwarfing the human and the rat. It reads clearly as a huge striped stone quadruped with orange seams against the ground.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the head facing the camera, with both eyes and the muzzle, between the forelegs.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the haunches and a segmented tail, with no face or eyes.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three facings are taken at the game's angled side camera. None is a top-down view.

SAME_SIZE.seen: The measured spread is 12%, within 15%, and the facings look equivalent in the shared-scale panel.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: The same banded stone plates, glowing seams, dorsal ridge and columnar legs appear on all facings. The dorsal ridge turns correctly: stepped peaks seen end-on in south and north, a lengthwise jagged crest in east. The tail is prominent in north but only a short drooping shape in east.

SIGNATURE.seen: Banded mineral plates with seams glowing orange-hot between them are visible on every facing.

ALIEN.seen: It reads as a living stone or geological megabeast, not a recoloured tortoise, rhino or elephant. The plated rock body and lava seams are not any Earth animal.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1. Banded hide of mineral, not skin or fur: present. The whole body is layered, striped rock plates.

STYLE.seen: Painterly, rendered rock texture with a soft dark edge. The face is small and slightly blocky-simple (straight mouth line, small round eyes), but it is not glossy or smiling.

OURS.seen: Bespoke art matching the description. This is not a vanilla or donor animal.

ALPHA.seen: Clean transparency on all facings, with no ground patch, shadow or halo.

OWNER_NOTES.seen: In scale.png at 32 px per cell it spans about 7 cells and towers over the human, so it reads as a true giant. The Zeer is not shown, so the comparison with it is inferred from the drawSize of 7.5 against 6.

SCALE.seen: A megafauna-sized body several times the human's height and length, which fits 'migratory megafauna'.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px per cell it reads as one bold striped grey-ochre mass with clear legs, a ridge and orange seams, standing apart from the ground.

reply.subject: RM_FurnaceBeast
reply.image_seen: A massive quadruped with banded stone plates, glowing orange seams, a raised dorsal ridge and a drooping segmented tail, shown from front, side and rear plus a human scale comparison.

concerns.evidence: In south.png, the eyes are small, recessed and narrowed beneath angular stone brows, without large glossy eyeballs. Overlapping mineral plates continue across the blunt muzzle; the straight mouth seam gives a neutral expression. The face supports the mineral anatomy rather than visibly introducing a cute or toy-like treatment.

In east.png, a substantial overlapping, segmented tail follows the far-left rump downward to a pointed tip above the feet. In north.png, the same broad-rooted, tapering tail hangs centrally and also ends above the feet. Its narrower side silhouette and overlap with the rump explain the apparent difference; it is not merely a short isolated plate.
